title: Killedmond, Borris, Killedmond, Co. Carlow
description:
Three bedroom house for rent in Killedmond, Borris, Co. Carlow. This country location is in a very quiet, scenic area at the foot of Mount Leinster. 

The house will be rented unfurnished and any furniture currently in the house will be taken away or can be used by new tenants if they wish.

Heating: Under floor heating, a solid fuel stove in Kitchen/Dining area and an open fire in sitting room. 

Doors: One front door. One back door in utility. Double doors in sun room area off the kitchen. 

The house contains:

A very large attic - (full length of house) all standing room for storage space (Reachable via a pull down stira attic stairs located near the front door).

One large bathroom with shower and bath.

Three double bedrooms (the main bedroom of which has an en-suite).

One large hot press with shelving.

A spacious hall.

One utility room (sink, washing machine, dryer & undercounter freezer).

kitchen with sun room. Contains dishwasher, oven, hob and fridge/freezer. 

Sitting room: Open fire and three windows facing towards the front of the house/Mount Leinster direction. 

Other Details: 
Internet: Fibre Broadband Connection available if tenant wishes to avail of this connection. Internet paid for by tenant.  
TV and TV Licence will be responsibility of tenant. 

This is a strictly No Smoking property******. 

Paint: All walls will be freshly painted. Colour:  An off white. 
Photos enclosed are last photos taken before the last tenant moved in and others of when the build was almost complete.  Updated photos will be uploaded once current tenant moves out. 

There are cream shiny/glossy tiles in kitchen and white and green marble tiles in the hall. There are solid oak wooden floors in sitting room and bedrooms. 

Garden at the front of the house and a very large garden at back with a washing line. Large garage beside house. Exceptionally clean and tidy location and the house is finished to a very high standard. 

Located right at the foot of Mount Leinster with spectacular views, the house may suit tenants who would like to live in the country and who may enjoy walking and hiking. It is near Borris, Bagenalstown, Carlow town, Wexford border and Kilkenny. Location: Borris (circa 4 miles). Bagenalstown (circa 7 miles).

The house is in excellent condition. PRTB registered and contract will be signed by new tenant and landlord. 

Rent €1750 per month by standing order. Deposit €1750.

This property will only suit exceptionally tidy and clean tenants. Please contact me within the area provided below with details as to why this house may suit you. All information will be treated in the strictest confidence**. It is important to us if you have the time to write some detail in your message as we will have many emails to read through and we may not have time to ring every contact by phone if you only leave contact details.

Viewings to the property are by appointment only.

Many thanks. Kind Regards.
